title: Khaitan & Co advises Tata Capital on majority stake acquisition in YOGLOANS
description: Tata Capital Limited has acquired a 88.6% majority stake in Kerala-based Yogakshemam Loans Limited, dba YOGLOANS.Khaitan & Co advised Tata Capital on this stake acquisition.The transaction team consisted of Surbhi Kejriwal (Partner), Vidushi Gupta (Partner), Vedika Bhandari (Principal Associate), Bimbita Kateel (Principal Associate), Arnav Bose (Senior Associate), Vivek Badkur (Senior Associate), and Nikhil Singh (Senior Associate).Yoagloans, for dealstreetBased in Kerala, YOGLOANS is an RBI
